A three-module augmented reality lab that teaches students how gradient descent works
in machine learning. The student sees a 3D loss surface in AR space. In the first module,
the loss surface appears and the student learns what the surface represents. In the second
module, a ball rolls down the surface showing iterative gradient steps, with annotations
showing the gradient direction and step size. In the third module, students compare two
learning rates to see how step size affects convergence.
